place_a2b_left.range_evidence: The hash-bound episode prompt block expresses placing object A to the left of object B; episode 11550 begins the right-relation block.

open_microwave.range_evidence: The hash-bound episode prompt block consistently expresses opening the microwave.

move_stapler_pad.range_evidence: The hash-bound episode prompt block consistently expresses moving a stapler onto a mat/pad.

domain.label: protocol_v2_hash_bound_range_partition
domain.note: Protocol v2 defines the first 50 episodes of each hash-bound 550-episode task block as Clean and the following 500 as Official Random. The release metadata has no intrinsic domain field; this claim is scoped only to these exact metadata hashes and episode ranges.

selection_modes.native_99pct: Legacy compatibility mode: reproduce FastWAM's seed-42 global 99/1 episode split and intersect it with the three task blocks.
selection_modes.full_550_per_task: Stage1 protocol mode: disable the native validation split and load exactly 50 Clean + 500 Official Random episodes for each task.

selection_contract.episode_anchor: lower midpoint frame of each episode
